workflow add stage
=====================

Synopsis
""""""""

**workflow add stage** [*options*]


Description
""""""""""""

Initiates a text-based guided prompt to add a stage to the workflow. 
Information can alternatively be added via options.

Options
""""""""
**-n** *name*, **\--name** *name*
   Name of the new stage.

**-d** *dependencies*, **\--dependencies** *dependencies*
   Comma-separated list of upstream stages that this stage depends on.

**-v** *variables*, **\--variables** *variables*
   Comma-separated list of variable names associated with this stage.
